description: factionID -> cosmetic slot to mesh material layer. slotID is the cosmetic slot (1 primary_nanocoating, 2 secondary_nanocoating, 3 tertiary_nanocoating, 4 tech_area); materialID is the mesh material layer (material1-4) that slot's component feeds. The pattern material slots are not faction-dependent: slot 6 always feeds patternMaterial1 and slot 8 patternMaterial2. factionID is an attribute of a typeID, NOT a SOF faction - the two do not map onto each other, and v1 of this file was keyed by SOF faction name in error. The values are unchanged from v1 and were verified to agree for every entry v1 could be named; the shape matches the pending ESI endpoint so the consumer can swap the authored copy for the served one without a conversion.
completeness: COMPLETE at sixteen entries - do not treat the absences as gaps. SDE build 3458726 has 569 ship types, 506 of which carry a factionID, and they claim nineteen distinct factions: these sixteen plus 500005 (Jove Empire), 500006 (CONCORD Assembly) and 500009 (The Syndicate). Those three cover seventeen hulls, ten of them published (Capsule, Zephyr, Echelon, Council Diplomatic Shuttle, Pacifier, Enforcer, Marshal, Monitor and two more), and none of them can be used in SKINR - so they have no cosmetic slot conversion to author. A hull of those factions correctly falls through to the consumer's slot-order fallback. Conversely every entry here is claimed by at least one hull, so there are no dead rows either.
